[00:13.17]主，你本为大，当受极大赞美，
[00:22.40]在我们神至圣城中，
[00:29.63]愿全地都喜乐，
[00:39.86]主，在你里面我们已有权柄，
[00:48.08]能战胜黑暗众仇敌，
[00:55.30]今向你来敬拜。
[01:05.52]主，我们高举你至圣尊名，
[01:12.73]主，我们何等感谢，
[01:15.93]因你为我成就大事，
[01:18.14]主，我们信靠你无比大爱，
[01:24.37]主，惟有你是永远上帝，
[01:29.61]你圣名在天地之上。

May all the earth rejoice

To overcome every enemy of darkness
Now we come to worship You
Lord, we exalt Your most holy and honored name
Lord, how thankful we are
For You have done great things for me
Lord, we trust in Your incomparable love
Lord, You alone are the eternal God
Your holy name is above heaven and earth
